title: Compact price-only Fed/SPX endpoint control
question: Does the compact CNN improve on zero return for 20- and 30-minute SPX Close forecasts given only pre-release prices?
configuration: Fed/SPX alignment v1; 35 pre-release OHLC inputs, 20- and 30-minute Close returns from the forecast origin. RTX 4060, seeds 0–2, 30 epochs, 20-minute validation MAE checkpoint selection.
limitations: Validation only; price-eligible cohort. The text comparison uses a future common, timing-verified cohort.
